models_evaluated: commercially available AI system for prostate biopsy reporting

links.outcome: Pathologist diagnosis, turnaround time, and IHC use with vs without AI assistance
links.effect: Second-read AI changed diagnosis or Grade Group in 21/386 (5.4%), 5 (1.3%) potentially affecting management; concurrent-read reduced mean turnaround by 30.1 h at one site; IHC reduced at all sites (ORs 0.50, 0.43, 0.33).
links.quote: AI-assisted workflows showed significantly reduced mean turnaround time with concurrent-read compared to unassisted-read by 30.1 h (p < 0.0001) at one site with significant reductions in cases requiring immunohistochemistry in all sites (Odds Ratios 0.50,0.43,0.33, p < 0.0001, p = 0.01, p = 0.001).
